title: systemd.unit.failed.v1
description: A systemd user unit entered the failed state, or a start of it failed (systemd also runs OnFailure= for each failed attempt while it auto-restarts).  Emitted by dee's dee-notify@UNIT.service, the OnFailure= of every unit dee manages, with producer 'dee'.  Subject: the unit name, e.g. 'syncthing.service'.

host.description: The dee host name of the account the unit runs under.

result.description: systemd's Result= of the unit: 'exit-code', 'signal', 'core-dump', 'timeout', 'start-limit-hit', 'protocol', 'resources', ...; empty if systemd didn't say.

status.description: ExecMainStatus=: the main process's exit status or signal number; null if unknown.

restarts.description: NRestarts=: automatic restarts so far; null if unknown.

log.description: The unit's last journal lines, oldest first.
